entries.f55b4fe46101d5eb: A support purchase service for new things and experiences. Under this mechanism, businesses sell new products and services before mass production, and supporters make advance purchases (support purchases); when a project succeeds, the company receives a support fee from the project executor and a system usage fee from supporters, which is used for maintaining the site environment and similar purposes. There are the All-in method, under which sales proceeds are provided to the executor regardless of whether the target is reached, and the All or Nothing method, under which they are provided only when the target amount is reached. Sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥3,301 million.
